SCAPULAR_LANDMARK_CADAVER_2026.citation: Scapular morphometrics inform anatomic landmark distances for arthroscopic suprascapular nerve decompression: a cadaveric study.
SCAPULAR_LANDMARK_CADAVER_2026.invalid_inference_withdrawn: The difference between the two STSL distances cannot infer a direct AC-to-acromion distance; they need not be collinear. The abstract omits a direct value, but a later full-text check found a separately reported direct measurement; see SCAPULA_AC_LATERAL_2026.
SCAPULAR_LANDMARK_CADAVER_2026.use: Do not use this paper to set transverse AC offset. Retain only as suprascapular-notch/STSL surgical-landmark evidence.

CLAVICLE_LENGTH_CT_SYMMETRY_2018.citation: Quantifying shortening of the fractured clavicle assuming clavicular symmetry is unreliable. 2018.
CLAVICLE_LENGTH_CT_SYMMETRY_2018.definition: 3D straight distance between the lateral-most clavicular point in the AC joint and the medial-most clavicular point in the SC joint.
CLAVICLE_LENGTH_CT_SYMMETRY_2018.caveat: Sex and side affect length; side-to-side asymmetry exists.

CLAVICLE_CADAVER_3D_2013.citation: The anatomy of the clavicle: a three-dimensional cadaveric study. Clin Anat. 2014.
CLAVICLE_CADAVER_3D_2013.definition: 3D centreline true length plus straight endpoint length.
CLAVICLE_CADAVER_3D_2013.use: Curved centreline vs straight endpoint invariant and adult-male true-length corridor.

SCAPULA_AC_LATERAL_2026.citation: Duru DO, Chaudhury S, Kang N, Brassett C. Scapular morphometrics inform anatomic landmark distances for arthroscopic suprascapular nerve decompression: a cadaveric study. JSES Int. 2026;10(3):101647.
SCAPULA_AC_LATERAL_2026.verified_access: Full text Results paragraph after Statistical analysis, independently rechecked 2026-10-08
SCAPULA_AC_LATERAL_2026.measurement_definition: Lateral acromion in line with posterior clavicle to posterior AC joint; anatomic distance, not a pure HGPT mediolateral component and not the centre of either joint.
limitations: 20 shoulders from 10 elderly White British cadavers; 5 male and 5 female; stature unavailable.
Does not independently define SC centres, AC centre offset or neutral scapular frame.
SCAPULA_AC_LATERAL_2026.historical_correction: The earlier STSL-distance subtraction remains invalid; the separately reported direct distance is usable as a 3D bound.

audit_correction_2026_10_08.issue: Earlier source transcription incorrectly registered lateral-acromion→AC as 34±8 mm (23-52).
audit_correction_2026_10_08.verified_source_result: Actual abstract reports lateral STSL→lateral acromion 77±10 mm and lateral STSL→AC 45±6 mm.
audit_correction_2026_10_08.consequence: All shoulder target logic that used a direct 34±8 mm AC offset has been withdrawn. Exact AC transverse offset remains open.
audit_correction_2026_10_08.full_text_followup: Direct measurement restored with separate provenance, without restoring transverse equality.
